rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent massing idea across all four views: a compact, terraced volume bent into a single continuous silhouette. The dominant gesture is legible, hierarchy is clear, and the non-rectangular footprint responds reasonably to the parcel rather than merely filling a box. The blue frontage edge is acknowledged only modestly: there is some ground-level compression and shape change, but no strongly carved public court or obvious entry seam aligned to the access edge, so void_publicness is only middling. Program-wise, the object can plausibly support neighborhood living / mixed-use because it maintains an occupiable base, upper mass hierarchy, and a calm, capacity-like section without collapsing into an arbitrary sculpture. It is not over-fragmented and the stepped form is coherent rather than code-like repetition, though it still feels more object-like than truly street-active.
